page.overview:
What is Bari Bari no Mi?

The Bari Bari no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to generate barriers, making them a . It was eaten by Kurozumi Semimaru, and upon its reincarnation it was eaten by Bartolomeo.

The fruit's bestowed power is to conjure physical barriers out of thin air—either invisible or visibly transparent, resembling tinted panes or domes of glass; this is often achieved by the user making a finger-crossing gesture, though this does not appear to be required. Such barriers can shield the user against attacks, usually from the front, but also from other (or even all) directions depending on a barrier's given shape and position.

The barriers boast immense defensive power. Bartolomeo has a high opinion of his barriers' strength, as he was confident that they were "unbreakable" and could stop Doflamingo's Birdcage (which can slice stone buildings and enormous meteorites with great ease). Powerful attacks that the Bari Bari no Mi's barriers were able to completely block without the slightest crack include:

The barrier can also be used for offensive purposes, such as by launching it forward to create powerful forces to strike targets, or to deflect forces sent by enemies right back at them. Another strength of this fruit Bartolomeo has displayed is the ability to form his barriers into solid constructs of various shapes, such as stairs which people can stand on, making this fruit useful for getting to hard-to-reach places.
